name: planted_function_defaults
notes: signature: compute_branch_coselection_network(attributions[L,N] float32, lrts[L] float32, branch_names[N], consensus_aas[L], min_sim=0.35, min_shared=2, max_fdr=0.05, min_lrt=1.0, min_cesi=2.0) -> (sig_pairs sorted by cesi desc, networkx Graph with nodes 1..L attrs ref/lrt and edges attrs weight/shared/cesi/fdr_q). Cosine on float32 inputs; t = sim*sqrt(df/(1-sim^2)) with df=max(1,N-2); p = t.sf; BH over all V(V-1)/2 active pairs (q cast to float32). Graph node order is 1..L insertion order. NOTE the CLI passes min_sim=0.30 (cli.py epistasis parser default) while the function default is 0.35. Planted: sites 3,7,11 share taxa {1,2,3,6}; sites 21,22,23 share taxa {8,9,10}; sites 31,32 inactive (1-indexed).
